The prophecy of 100 years is not of any importance, and must go the way of all prophecies. In the As'oka Avadana, a prophecy of S'akya is quoted, which says that Upa Gupta, the religious preceptor of As'oka, would be born a hundred years after the Nirvana. If this really did happen and the latest uate of tho Nirvana be accepted as the true one, tho sage would have been 131 years old when he expounded the principle of Buddhism to his royal pupil.
